svg.aria-label: atexit 手册页的 DESCRIPTION 段：atexit() 函数登记在程序正常终止时被调用的函数，通过 exit(3) 或从 main() 返回；登记的函数按逆序调用，且不传参数。图中用红框圈出 reverse order 两个词
svg.font-family: Seaford, 'Songti SC', STSong, SimSun, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', Palatino, 'Source Serif Pro', serif
svg.text: The atexit() function registers the given function to be called at normal process termination, either via
exit(3) or via return from the program's main(). Functions so registered are called in the reverse order of
their registration; no arguments are passed.
